nodes.description: malloc allocates uninitialized heap memory for the image buffer
Uninitialized byte from the image buffer is used as a palette index in qRgb computation

edges.description: readRawData returns fewer bytes than requested (short read), but the return value is discarded so no handling occurs
The uninitialized region left by the short read in the image buffer is later accessed by the src pointer during pixel conversion

root_cause_criterion.description: The fix captures the return value of readRawData into dataRead and checks (uint)dataRead < count, zero-filling the gap with memset when a short read is detected. The vulnerable code discards the return value entirely.
